_comment: Genuine range per module.metric. The verdict engine trusts THIS file, not the module. A row with calibrated=false is a placeholder: with allow_uncalibrated=false (verdict.json) the engine will not judge it.

diff_picture.block_diff_max.note: Upper edge includes held-out genuine reuploads; external image calibration remains 58 samples.

diff_picture.detail_dev_max.note: Upper edge includes held-out genuine reuploads; external image calibration remains 58 samples.

diff_picture.block_chroma_diff_max.note: Upper edge includes held-out genuine reuploads; external image calibration remains 58 samples.

diff_picture.video_block_diff_max.note: Calibrated upper bound measured on genuine H.264/H.265 video re-encodes.

diff_picture.video_detail_dev_max.note: Calibrated upper bound measured on genuine H.264/H.265 video re-encodes.

diff_picture.video_block_chroma_diff_max.note: Calibrated upper bound measured on genuine H.264/H.265 video re-encodes.

diff_transcript.word_error_rate.note: Transcript comparison threshold. Values above 0.35 indicate substantial word replacement or deletion after aligned ASR comparison.

diff_transcript.audio_correlation.note: Audio waveform threshold after aligned extraction. Values below 0.50 indicate substantially different or replaced audio.

diff_sync.mouth_sharpness_dev.note: Calibrated threshold measured on genuine face re-encodes. Values >0.35 indicate synthetic mouth blur or Wav2Lip edges.

diff_sync.mouth_motion_diff.note: Calibrated threshold measured on aligned video mouth regions. Values >25.0 indicate resynthesized mouth motion.

diff_sync.av_sync_correlation.note: Audio-visual speech envelope to mouth motion correlation. Values <0.55 indicate replaced audio or de-sync.
